scripts.start:dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.studio: npx prisma studio --port 5555 2>&1 | grep -v 'ERR_STREAM\|pipelineImpl\|stream/promises\|Cannot pipe\|at Ror\|at Server\|at process\|code:'
